title: RoadScope Ludhiana-area scored simulation handoff
dataset_status: SYNTHETIC DEMO ONLY. No actual road journey was recorded for these observations.
generation_method: Filtered the prior 1,440-row simulated fixture to its 1,228 existing scored rows. No risk values were fabricated or replaced in this filtering step.
excluded_reason: No primary condition evidence in source fixture, so risk_score was blank
excluded_geometries: 3 latest-run and 6 all-run features had no scored observations in their matching segment/run, so were omitted rather than given a made-up score
geometry_method: Retained simulated straight-connector geometry and relinked each feature to one existing scored observation from same simulated run and segment; representative row has risk score closest to simulated segment/run median.
coordinates: Invented plausible Ludhiana-area points. Not physically logged, not GPS fixes.
timestamps: Invented scenario timestamps. Not physically acquired.
sensor_readings: Invented scenario values. No ESP32 data was recorded in this output.
vision_predictions: Scenario inputs, not outputs of trained YOLO11n on these observations.
imu_predictions: Scenario inputs, not outputs of trained STRIDE RF on these observations.
roughness: Simulated surrogate PPE proxy, not matched SmartRoadSense measurements.
weather: Simulated contextual rainfall, not matched AgERA5 extracts.
risk_score: Calculated from synthetic scenario inputs using existing Objective 2 rule engine, not calibrated road safety or crash likelihood.
fusion_test_accuracy: Not evaluated: no independent labels or synchronized multimodal records.
geometries: Not road-centerline mapped, surveyed or derived from verified OSM road geometries.
unassessed_handling: 212 unscored observations omitted from scored-only demo; original source retains them with blank risk_score.
legacy_csv: 19-column legacy CSV maps native Low to Normal and High/Critical to Severe; use exact 17-column CSV for native statuses.
original_81_6_hybrid: Preserved separately and unchanged. Not paired with the synthetic route.
